description.value: Co-op Skidegate Food Store is a member-owned grocery co-operative in Skidegate on Haida Gwaii, part of the Haida Gwaii Co-op network that also serves Masset. In this remote island community, it serves as one of the primary food resupply points for cyclists exploring the archipelago. No membership is required to shop — anyone can walk in as a regular customer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Haida Gwaii Co-op serving Skidegate; OSM tags shop=supermarket and the business is named 'Food Store,' which together confirm basic groceries. No amenity-specific information (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) appears in either the OSM tags or website content, so those fields default to null. The website URL matches the OSM tag and the site loaded successfully, but fetched content is heavily cluttered with CMS template artifacts offering little detail beyond the co-op's identity and membership FAQ.
concerns: Website content is heavily cluttered with unrendered CMS template artifacts (e.g. '${title}', '${loading}'), meaning amenity details could not be verified from the fetched HTML.
OSM name 'Co-op Skidegate Food Store' differs slightly from the website branding 'Haida Gwaii Co-op', though both clearly refer to the same Skidegate location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active grocery co-operative in a remote Haida Gwaii community — an essential resupply stop for any touring cyclist in the region.
